name: event.tick
description: The scheduler's hourly step of a brand's events feed: a pull now (event.pull, with the caller's yes) for the window from 14 days back to 78 days ahead, Singapore days, and the next step in an hour. A step that is not the feed's next one does nothing, so starting the feed again never runs it twice.
sql:
with t as (
  update brandbase.event_feeds f set next_at = :now::timestamptz + interval '1 hour'
  where f.brand_id = :brand and f.next_at = :at::timestamptz
  returning f.brand_id, f.next_at
),
w as (
  select (:now::timestamptz at time zone 'Asia/Singapore')::date - 14 as first_day
)
select jsonb_build_object('brand', :brand, 'nextAt', (select brandbase.iso(t.next_at) from t)) as result,
  (select jsonb_build_array(
     jsonb_build_object('op', 'event.pull', 'at', brandbase.iso(:now::timestamptz), 'key', t.brand_id, 'approve', true,
       'input', jsonb_build_object('brand', t.brand_id, 'at', brandbase.iso(:at::timestamptz), 'from', to_char(w.first_day, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
         'to', to_char(w.first_day + 92, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))),
     jsonb_build_object('op', 'event.tick', 'at', brandbase.iso(t.next_at), 'key', t.brand_id || ':' || brandbase.iso(t.next_at),
       'input', jsonb_build_object('brand', t.brand_id, 'at', brandbase.iso(t.next_at))))
   from t, w) as schedule
